name: 63334 · Bowling Green, MO
findings: ZIP 63334 (Bowling Green) has 48 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (78% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 63334 (Bowling Green) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
44% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
